## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag should be fixed before merge because it ignores the project rule that new flags take their default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable. This review found no other defects in the exclusion logic or its tests.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag. `collect` uses it to skip any file whose basename matches one of the patterns. The pull request also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds tests for parsing, filtering and archive contents.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default --exclude from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and runs `archive src`, no files are excluded, because the flag uses `default=[]` and never reads the environment. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that pass options through the environment silently archive files they meant to exclude. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, decide how one variable holds several patterns (for example, separated by `os.pathsep`), and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover the variable.
